models._description: Common functions for EDI documents: generate the data, the constraints, etc
(extension) e-invoice XML attachment + import/export entry points
(extension) embeds UBL/CII XML into the sent PDF/email
(extension) UBL/CII tax category + exemption reason codes

behavioral_notes.observation: Inbound XML routing: _get_import_file_type sniffs the root tag, UBLVersionID and CustomizationID of the parsed xml_tree to pick the right format model (e.g. CII -> account.edi.xml.cii; 'xrechnung' in CustomizationID -> ubl_de; the en16931/peppol billing:3.0 CustomizationID -> ubl_bis3). _get_edi_decoder then returns the matching model's _import_invoice_ubl_cii as the decoder with priority 20. This dispatch logic is pure Python and invisible in metadata.

UBL export pipeline: validates the tax structure, builds a structured document_node dict via _get_invoice_node (header, AccountingSupplierParty, lines, LegalMonetaryTotal, tax subtotals), selects an Invoice/CreditNote/DebitNote template + nsmap (cac/cbc/ext), evaluates _export_invoice_constraints (EN16931 business rules like BR-08/BR-09/BR-CO-26), then renders bytes with dict_to_xml. Returns a (xml_bytes, errors_set) tuple, so a structurally-invalid invoice is reported rather than silently shipped.

Inbound parse-to-record: refuses to decode onto a move that already has invoice lines, derives move_type and qty_factor (credit-note sign flip) from the tree, prefixes out_/in_ from the journal type, then _import_fill_invoice walks the XML (xpath via _find_value) to retrieve-or-create the partner (_import_partner, matched on VAT/Peppol EAS+endpoint), set currency, bank and lines; afterwards _correct_invoice_tax_amount overrides Odoo-computed tax when it is <0.05 off the XML total, the source attachment is stamped onto ubl_cii_xml_file, and embedded AdditionalDocumentReference PDFs are extracted as attachments. None of this side-effect chain is visible in metadata.

PDF<->XML round-trip on send: after the invoice PDF is rendered the hook post-processes the UBL XML and, for facturx/zugferd, always silently embeds a Factur-X XML inside the PDF (PDF/A-3) so the receiver can recover the structured data from the PDF alone. The XML is also added as an extra mail attachment via _get_invoice_extra_attachments. This is a generation side-effect of posting/sending, not a stored field.

Format-to-builder strategy table: the recipient partner's invoice_edi_format (xrechnung, facturx/zugferd, ubl_a_nz, nlcius, ubl_bis3, ubl_sg) maps to the concrete abstract export model that builds its XML; facturx and zugferd share account.edi.xml.cii. account.move._need_ubl_cii_xml gates export to sale documents / self-billing whose partner format is a real UBL/CII format. The localisation-specific format selection is code, not declarative configuration.

No OWL components, JS files, registry adds or patches; the only asset is one backend SCSS bundle entry (web.assets_backend). The module is a headless EDI engine driven entirely from the existing Accounting UI (invoice form Send/Print, journal Advanced Settings, partner & tax form fields added via 3 static XML views).

information_flows: side-effect: account.move.send (post/print) -> builder._export_invoice -> UBL/CII XML attachment embedded in invoice PDF (PDF/A-3 Factur-X)
side-effect: inbound XML/PDF -> _get_edi_decoder -> _import_invoice_ubl_cii -> account.move + account.move.line (+ retrieve/create res.partner)
side-effect: _import_fill_invoice -> _correct_invoice_tax_amount overrides computed account.tax amounts to match the XML

capabilities: Import Electronic Invoices (parse XML/PDF into vendor bills & customer invoices)
E-invoicing Format Compliance (EN16931, Peppol BIS 3, XRechnung, NLCIUS, Factur-X, A-NZ, SG)
Map Tax Categories & Exemption Reasons to UBL/CII codes
value_streams: Outbound: posted invoice -> chosen EDI format -> validated UBL/CII XML -> XML embedded in PDF / emailed to customer
Inbound: received XML or Factur-X PDF -> format detection -> parsed account.move (bill/invoice) with partner, lines, taxes
policies: EDI format selection driven by partner invoice_edi_format / journal advanced settings
Export constraints enforce EN16931 / format business rules (BR-*) before a document is emitted
Auto-install with account: every Accounting database gains UBL/CII import-export by default
stakeholders: Tax / Regulatory authority (Chorus Pro, Peppol network, national mandates)

classification.rationale: account_edi_ubl_cii is a support activity: it adds no primary-chain value of its own but enforces e-invoicing compliance and feeds the accounting back-office. It serializes/parses invoices to and from legally mandated formats (EN16931, Peppol BIS 3, Factur-X, XRechnung, NLCIUS) around account.move, with no models, routes, or UI of its own beyond Accounting. It supports APQC 9.0 Manage Financial Resources (specifically 9.2 receivables / 9.5 payables document exchange) rather than producing, selling, or delivering. value_model 'support' per Stabell & Fjeldstad: it is an infrastructure/compliance enabler for the firm's invoicing rather than a value chain, shop, or network in its own right.

standard_capabilities: Export invoices as UBL Bis 3 / EHF3, NLCIUS, XRechnung (UBL), Factur-X & XRechnung (CII), E-FFF, A-NZ, SG
Embed the UBL/CII XML inside the invoice PDF (PDF/A-3 Factur-X) for portability
Auto-detect inbound format from CustomizationID/UBLVersionID/root tag and import into account.move
Retrieve-or-create the partner on import (VAT / Peppol EAS+endpoint matching)
Validate exports against EN16931 / format business rules and surface the errors
typical_fits: EU/EEA company that must issue and receive standards-compliant e-invoices
Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF round-trip with French (Chorus Pro) or German (XRechnung) counterparties
Peppol BIS 3 exchange where the partner Peppol endpoint/EAS is known
Automatic vendor-bill creation from emailed XML/Factur-X via an invoicing alias
common_gaps: Actual Peppol Access Point transmission (this module only builds/parses the XML; network delivery is a separate Peppol module)
Country-specific mandates beyond the bundled CIUS (clearance models, new national formats)
Custom tax-category / exemption-reason mappings for edge regimes
Bespoke field mappings or extra UBL extensions not covered by the standard builders
